localize.text: Ends per inch, picks per inch, stitch per inch. Important!
"That's not even a Milanese buttonhole." "Shirting needs to be over 200-count."
No hand sewing survives on one pair of hands alone. A host of practiced artisans are needed to breathe life into it.
"Bring... it to me...!" "More... More...! Not... enough...!"
"Ugh, I can see the stitching on the outside." "There, I can see two rows of stitching there. Rejected."
To remove a fixed nail, one must first come to a brief halt.
"Wait... the stitch-per-inch count is way too even. You used a machine, didn't you?" "It's not bespoke if it's not hand-stitched."
